summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built embedded firmware in C and C++ for microcontrollers, including bare-metal STM32 drivers (GPIO, ADC, I2C, timers), UART/I2C/SPI communication protocols and closed-loop control algorithms. Tested and troubleshot hardware and firmware in the lab with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and produced documentation and BOMs for design reviews.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C for a microcontroller with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz; verified through Proteus simulation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Troubleshot and resolved 11 hardware and firmware integration failures (servo brown-out, false-positive detections, stale frames); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Implemented two-link IK (control algorithm) on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection over a hardware interface of I2C ToF sensors.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction on Arduino Due: quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR) fed angular error into rotation PWM, holding course during translation.
Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding as a 4-bit A/B state machine; drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM.
